chapters.title: One handle. Two heads.
chapters.caption: Pressure cartridge + vibration head
chapters.detail: A shared twist-lock interface, with built-in contacts proposed.

chapters.title: 1. Release the safety slider
chapters.caption: Power off, then slide the latch back
chapters.detail: The teal collar stays captive on the handle.

chapters.title: 2. Turn only the collar
chapters.caption: Rotate the collar 30 degrees to unlock
chapters.detail: The keyed head stays still, keeping the contacts aligned.

chapters.title: 3. Pull the pressure head out
chapters.caption: Withdraw the complete head straight ahead
chapters.detail: The electrical contacts separate with the joint.

chapters.title: 4. Align the vibration head
chapters.caption: Match the key before inserting
chapters.detail: Both heads use the same mechanical connection.

chapters.title: 5. Push the head home
chapters.caption: Seat the head straight into the handle
chapters.detail: The proposed spring contacts meet the handle pads.

chapters.title: 6. Lock the collar and slider
chapters.caption: Return the collar, then slide the latch forward
chapters.detail: The head remains stationary throughout locking.

chapters.title: Vibration through a rounded tip
chapters.caption: A motor inside the head would drive the tip
chapters.detail: Wave graphics are schematic; output and frequency are unvalidated.

chapters.title: More room for a readable display
chapters.caption: Enclosure sized for a 1.3-inch OLED
chapters.detail: Screen content is a visual mockup. Pressure head shown reattached.

chapters.title: 1. Turn the cartridge hub
chapters.caption: Hold the gold hub and rotate 30 degrees
chapters.detail: The pressure head can remain attached to the handle.

chapters.title: 2. Pull out the whole cartridge
chapters.caption: The filament and its hub come out together
chapters.detail: Handle the hub; avoid touching or bending the nylon.

chapters.title: 3. Insert a prepared replacement
chapters.caption: Align the cartridge lugs and push the hub home
chapters.detail: The replacement is shown with its filament already fixed in place.

chapters.title: 4. Turn the cartridge to lock
chapters.caption: Return the hub to its locked position
chapters.detail: Filament geometry, calibration and hygiene still need validation.

chapters.title: Manual application of the filament
chapters.caption: The user moves the handle; the filament deflects
chapters.detail: Illustrative flex on a test surface. No force measurement or calibration.

chapters.title: Modular heads. Replaceable contact part.
chapters.caption: One pressure filament, changed as a complete cartridge
chapters.detail: R04 is a review prototype; physical operation remains to be tested.
